DeviceProfile.title: DeviceProfile
DeviceProfile.description: Represents a visually impaired user's registered Android device profile and live accessibility state in Firebase Firestore.

isPowerOn.description: Whether emergency screen protection and auto-assist power is active.

isServiceEnabled.description: Whether the Android Accessibility Service is active.

lastSignalSummary.description: Bengali summary of the latest accessibility or emergency signal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AccessibilitySignal.title: AccessibilitySignal
AccessibilitySignal.description: Represents a real-time accessibility or emergency signal sent or received by a visually impaired user via Firebase Firestore.

id.description: Unique document ID for the signal.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase User UID who owns this signal.

deviceId.description: Device identifier originating or receiving the signal.

signalType.description: Category of the accessibility or emergency signal.

command.description: Executable command payload or action code.

messageBn.description: Accessible Bengali voice/display description of the signal.

priority.description: Delivery priority for emergency vs standard signals.

status.description: Current execution lifecycle status of the signal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the signal was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the signal was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated visually impaired user's device profile and live power/service status.

/users/{userId}/signals/{signalId}.description: Stores real-time emergency and accessibility signals for the user's device.

/phone_users/{phoneKey}.description: Stores phone-number-identified visually impaired user's device profile and live power/service status.

/phone_users/{phoneKey}/signals/{signalI.description: Stores real-time emergency and accessibility signals keyed by the user's normalized phone number.
